claims.text: The rider's side of this pickup was live to the last message. The chat log shows every driver message delivered and read within about fifteen seconds (read receipts 16:02:44, 16:03:01, 16:07:29), the rider's own reply 'coming coming 2 min' sent at 16:08:02 and read at 16:08:11, the driver's 'ok no problem' at 16:08:20, and a 34-second in-app call placed by the driver at 16:09:40 which the rider answered. Limb (a) of the rider-contact clause asks whether the rider sent a locating or coordinating message during the waiting window; an ETA for reaching the vehicle is coordinating content, and the rider makes out that limb. She does not press the clause as a whole, because limb (b) fails on this record (the driver replied 18 seconds after her message and placed an answered in-app call before terminating) and limb (c) is failed on the trace. The rider relies on this record for the narrower point that she was engaged and reachable, and that nothing in it supports a suggestion that she ignored the driver or could not be reached.

Rider presence is not an element of the no-show charge and the rider's distance from the pin cannot be used to supply one. Every condition in POL-NS-01 runs off the driver's record - the 'arrived' event, the geofence position, the measured dwell, and the termination code - and POL-NS-06 fixes the refund 'whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded'. The rider accepts that the trace's rider block shows 141 fixes, none of them qualifying inside the 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE, and a distance from the pickup pin of 633.9 to 646.4 m, and she does not ask the Judge to find that she was standing at the pickup point. Her point is that this fact answers none of the four conditions and must not be weighed as though it did.

No adverse finding and no escalation can be built out of either profile. The rider's prior_no_show_flags of 3 is a lifetime counter which POL-GEN-01 lists as context only and which may not be substituted for the trailing-window rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which stands at 1 and falls short of the 3-or-more threshold in POL-NS-09(d); disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged either. The rider asks the Judge to record in the reasoning that her history carries no ground of decision and that escalation on abuse grounds is not available on this record.

The traffic advisory does not exist, and its absence proves nothing against the rider. EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING, with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT at severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload. Under POL-GEN-02 a MISSING artifact can carry no fact and its absence is itself citable, so nothing may be asserted from it; in particular, no advisory can be used to extend, excuse or accumulate the waiting clock under POL-NS-06(i), whose limb the derived block records as unavailable on this trip. The rider asks the Judge to disregard any assertion built on an artifact that is not in the bundle.

The rider states plainly what she cannot support rather than stretching a clause to fit it. There is no waiting-period shortfall under POL-NS-06: the derived trace records one continuous in-geofence run of 585 seconds (16:02:10 to 16:11:55, 60 qualifying fixes) against a LARGE_VENUE minimum of 300 seconds. There is no false arrival marker under POL-NS-05: the 16:02:25 'arrived' event falls inside that run, so the trace does not place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the marker. POL-NS-02 is satisfied because qualifying in-radius fixes exist, and POL-NS-03 is closed to the rider because those fixes put the driver inside the 120 m arrival radius rather than outside it. The rider's submission is confined to the points argued above, and to her request that nothing be added to the driver's side of the scale that the record does not contain.

claims.text: The trip record contains a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-07-30T16:02:25+08:00, so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the record without any inference.

The GPS trace, which is unbroken at 10-second cadence with 100 percent coverage and no gaps, places the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 16:02:10 — fifteen seconds BEFORE the arrived event — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, comfortably meeting POL-NS-02's requirement of at least 3 consecutive in-radius fixes at 25 m accuracy or better. POL-NS-01 limb (b) is therefore satisfied.

The driver held position inside the geofence in a single continuous run of 585 seconds, from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix as POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires. That is 285 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for the LARGE_VENUE zone class, so the required dwell is met with almost double the minimum.

There is no waiting-period shortfall to trigger a refund under POL-NS-06: the effective in-geofence dwell of 585 seconds against the 300-second minimum produces a shortfall of minus 285 seconds. The clause is simply not engaged.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the termination came after the required dwell had elapsed at 16:07:10, with no boarding event anywhere in the record. Limb (d) is satisfied.

POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the 16:02:25 arrival marker the driver was already stationary inside the arrival radius at 0 kph, not more than 300 m from the pin and nowhere near the 15 kph motion threshold, so the marker is not a false-arrival event.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider, because limb (b) fails outright: the rider's single coordinating message at 16:08:02 was answered by the driver 18 seconds later at 16:08:20, far inside the 120-second window, and the driver additionally placed an answered 34-second in-app voice call at 16:09:40. Where the driver replied in time, the clause does not apply.

Even the rider-presence limb of POL-NS-04 is affirmatively failed, not merely undecidable: the rider's own device track is available and records 141 fixes that never come closer than 633.9 m to the pin, yielding 0 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. The rider was nowhere near the pickup point throughout the wait.

The chat log corroborates the driver's account independently of the GPS: the system 'Your driver has arrived' fired at 16:02:26, the driver posted his plate and location at 16:02:40 and again at 16:07:15, every message was delivered and read, and the rider answered 'coming coming 2 min' at 16:08:02 — an acknowledgement that she was still coming and had not yet reached the vehicle.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged, because the driver was stationary INSIDE the arrival radius at the pickup pin rather than outside it; the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling is not reached on the driver's side. There is no wrong-face-of-the-venue case here for the rider to exploit.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 entitles the driver to 80 percent of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee, being SGD 6.40, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and the ratio against 143 completed trips in 30 days is 0.014, below 0.08. Both limbs of the check must fail to withhold, and both do.

The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is correct and cannot be attacked as a billing defect under POL-NS-08(d): under fee_schedule.resolution_rule the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee is SGD 8.00, which is exactly the line itemised, and the fare breakdown reconciles with a difference of 0.00.

EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no traffic advisory covers Depot Road in this window. I disclose that impairment and do not rely on it: no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed, because the driver's time in the geofence is a single unbroken 585-second run, so the absent advisory neither helps nor hurts either side.

ruling.explanation:
This ruling concerns the SGD 8.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on your 30 July 2026 booking, and both of you should read it.

To the rider: your account that the driver never turned up is not supported by the record. The GPS trace is unbroken at 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, with no gaps, and it shows the driver inside the pickup geofence at The Interlace main guardhouse from 16:02:10, holding position in a single continuous run of 585 seconds until 16:11:55. That is nearly double the 300-second minimum for a large-venue pickup, and it comfortably satisfies POL-NS-02 (60 qualifying in-radius fixes, well over the 3 required at 25 m accuracy or better). The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25, which is inside that run, so the arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. The trip was terminated at 16:12:10 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, and there is no boarding event. All four conditions of POL-NS-01 therefore hold and the fee was properly chargeable.

On the points your side argued: POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you, because the driver replied to your 16:08:02 'coming coming 2 min' eighteen seconds later at 16:08:20 and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40, so limb (b) fails; and limb (c) fails affirmatively on your own device track, which records 141 fixes never closer than 633.9 m to the pin against a 150 m radius. Your presence is not an element of the no-show charge, so nothing turns on it either way. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00208-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact and is not needed here, because the driver's dwell is one unbroken qualifying run and no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is involved. Your profile history — prior_no_show_flags of 3, a lifetime counter, and every other profile field except the ones a clause names — is context only under POL-GEN-01 and has not been weighed against you. There is no shortfall under POL-NS-06 and no wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03 (the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it). Your refund claim is therefore not supported and the charge stands.

To the driver: the fee stands, and under POL-NS-07 you are entitled to 80% of the SGD 8.00 cancellation fee, being SGD 6.40, with the residual 20% retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not bite: your no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and the ratio against 143 completed trips in 30 days is 0.014, below 0.08; both limbs must fail to withhold, and neither does. The SGD 8.00 line reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee), so no billing defect arises under POL-NS-08(d).

No artifact in the bundle is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d): there is no clock skew beyond 90 seconds, no sampling gap, a complete chat log matching the trip record's count, and a reconciled fare line. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present, and no clause produces a referral in this case. The charge is left as it stands and the driver's compensation of SGD 6.40 is paid.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: I have reviewed the whole record and I decide as follows.

The SGD 8.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is owed SGD 6.40.

WHY THE FEE STANDS. POL-NS-01 requires four things of the driver, and all four are met. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 16:02:25 on 30 July. (b) The GPS trace — unbroken, 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps — puts the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius from 16:02:10, fifteen seconds before that marker, with 60 qualifying fixes, so the arrival geofence test under POL-NS-02 is satisfied. (c) The dwell is measured from that first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the tap, and runs continuously to 16:11:55 — 585 seconds against the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 16:12:10, after the required dwell had elapsed at 16:07:10, with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, and there is no boarding event anywhere in the record.

WHY NO RIDER-SIDE CLAUSE DISPLACES IT. POL-NS-06 needs a waiting-period shortfall; there is none — the measured dwell exceeds the minimum by 285 seconds, and the rider does not contest this. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the 16:02:25 marker the driver was already stationary inside the arrival radius at 0 km/h, so the marker is not a false-arrival event and there is no referral to record under POL-NS-05(ii). POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider because limb (b) fails outright: the driver replied to her 16:08:02 message at 16:08:20, 18 seconds later, and placed an answered 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: it concerns a driver stationary outside the arrival radius but within 400 m, and this driver held position inside the radius.

TWO POINTS THE RIDER RAISES, BOTH ACCEPTED, NEITHER CHANGING THE OUTCOME. First, she correctly says the rider's distance from the pin is not an element of the charge and must not be weighed as though it were; her track (141 fixes, none qualifying inside the 150 m presence radius, 633.9 m at closest) answers none of the four conditions, and I do not weigh it against her. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00208-01, weight 0.0) carries no fact and was relied on by neither side, so it changes nothing.

No referral is issued. The result is DRIVER_COMPENSATION: the charge to the rider stands, and the driver receives SGD 6.40.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this ruling concerns the SGD 8.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00208.

Rider, your claim that the driver never came is not borne out by the record. The GPS trace is unbroken at 10-second intervals with 100% coverage and shows the driver holding at the main guardhouse — the pickup pin — for one continuous 585-second run, from 16:02:10 to 16:11:55. The fee therefore stands; it is not refunded.

The charge rests on the four conditions of POL-NS-01, and all four hold. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 16:02:25. (b) The trace places the driver inside the LARGE_VENUE arrival radius (120 m of the pin) from 16:02:10 — before the arrival tap — with 60 qualifying in-radius fixes, far more than the three required. (c) His dwell inside the geofence was a single continuous 585 seconds, measured from the first qualifying fix as the clause requires, nearly double the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip was ended by the driver at 16:12:10 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one the clause recognises, with no boarding event recorded and after the required dwell had elapsed. POL-NS-02 is satisfied on the same fixes, and POL-NS-06 produces no shortfall (585 seconds against a 300-second minimum).

Your own device track stayed about 640 m from the pin (Block 5, inside the estate) with no qualifying fix inside the 150 m rider-presence radius. I record that the rider's distance from the pin answers none of the four conditions of POL-NS-01, and POL-NS-06 refunds 'whether or not the rider was present', so that fact is not weighed against you.

The rider-side clauses do not displace the fee. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) does not apply: you did send a coordinating message ('coming coming 2 min', 16:08:02), but the driver replied 18 seconds later at 16:08:20 and placed a 34-second in-app call at 16:09:40 that you answered, so limb (b) fails. POL-NS-05 (false arrival marker) does not apply: at the 16:02:25 tap the driver was stationary inside the arrival radius, not more than 300 m away and not moving at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply: the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it, so the 400 m ceiling is never reached. The chat log is complete — 6 messages, matching the trip record's count, every one delivered and read — and corroborates the driver independently of the GPS.

The fee amount is correct: under the resolution rule the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 8.00 RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee is SGD 8.00, exactly the line itemised, so there is no billing defect under POL-NS-08(d). The bundle is intact — no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat gap, no fare mismatch — so nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d) and no limb is left undecided. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00208-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact, and its absence changes nothing here, because the driver's hold was a single unbroken run and no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) was ever needed. Under POL-GEN-02(3) I name it and record that the finding does not depend on it.

Driver, you are compensated under POL-NS-07 at 80% of the SGD 8.00 fee, being SGD 6.40. The anti-farming check does not trip — 2 no-show terminations in 30 days against 143 completed trips is below both the count and the rate thresholds — so the compensation is paid and the rider's charge stands as it presently is. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd.

On the profiles: prior_no_show_flags, ratings, lifetime counts and account ages are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry no ground of decision in this case. Escalation on abuse grounds is not available — rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3) and disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09(a)–(e) applies, and no clause produces a referral. The rider's request for a call is noted, but no clause directs one; it is an open request, not a referral. Confidence is 0.90, capped by the full-weight GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding facts.
